english.title: Publish an advertisement for a reward for the return of stolen goods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) published a public advertisement of a reward for the return of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), which had been stolen or lost and in the said advertisement used words to the effect that

(A)_[no questions would be asked.]_
(B)_[the person producing the said goods would be safe from apprehension or enquiry.]_
(C)_[any money paid for the purchase of the said goods would be repaid.]_
(D)_[any money advanced by way of loan on the said goods would be repaid.]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY - WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE OPTIONS APPLIES..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23 of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
published public advertisement of reward for return of goods stolen/lost
words implying no questions asked/person producing safe from apprehension or enquiry/money repaid/loan repaid

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: If more than one of options A to D applies, the options may be adapted or amalgamated in option E.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Cyhoeddi hysbyseb am wobr ar gyfer dychwelyd nwyddau wedi'u dwyn
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi gyhoeddi hysbyseb cyhoeddus am wobr ar gyfer dychwelyd nwyddau wedi'u dwyn, sef **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), a oedd wedi'u dwyn neu a gollwyd, a defnyddiwyd yn yr hysbyseb hwnnw, eiriau a oedd yn rhoi'r argraff

(A)_[na ofynnid unrhyw gwestiynau]_
(B)_[y byddai'r unigolyn a fyddai'n dychwelyd y cyfryw eiddo yn ddiogel ac na ofynnir unrhyw gwestiynau iddynt]_
(C)_[y telir arian yn ôl os talwyd am y cyfryw eiddo]_
(D)_[yr ad-delir unrhyw arian a gafwyd ar ffurf benthyciad er mwyn talu am y cyfryw eiddo]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY - WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS APPLIES..)]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 23 Deddf Dwyn 1968.
